mathematics.assertion_tested: The additional canonical vertex bisection baseline produces sound certificates on every recorded development world; original policy costs and worlds are preserved.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact binary graph states and integer query costs
mathematics.conventions: The added selector maximizes distance along the possible path to the nearest evaluated position; ties use lowest vertex index. This is a vertex adaptation of Dellin and Srinivasa 2016 Algorithm 2, specified in the amendment.
inputs: All 760 recorded development worlds, seeds 1000 through 1009
Original five-policy results for comparison only
non_claims: No alteration of the original five-policy efficiency criterion

randomness.generator: Recorded development worlds only; added policy is deterministic
